evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically from ~6 ppm at ramp to 51.5 ppm through growth
Tube pressure climbing steadily 2.98 -> 3.44 Torr at constant Ar setpoint 100 sccm
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so pressure/O2 rise is not from flow change
Temperature holding 750 °C at setpoint with normal heater power
